text:
nina: noticed invoice-preview for tenant t-alpha jumped ~2x after deploy. looks related to clients switching from streaming->batch in the same session.

asher: sample events?

nina: redacted: 
```
{"request_id":"req-42","tenant":"t-alpha","route":"fast","mode":"stream","tokens":30}
...later...
{"request_id":"req-42","tenant":"t-alpha","route":"fast-batch","mode":"batch","tokens":28}
```

leo: preview pipeline keys by route which causes the same session to appear under two groups. ledger dedupes by request_id so it's stable.

asher: quick mitigation: coalesce by request_id in preview when present. cheaper than proto change.

nina: agree. can we add a feature flag and canary?

leo: yes. patch plan: if request_id present, group by request_id for the window; else fall back to route key. will add 1% sampling logs for missing ids.

metering-bot: ticket MET-3000 created: "preview coalesce by request_id"

asher: rollout: canary 5% tenants 30m, watch preview vs ledger delta and CPU. rollback -> flip flag.

nina: I'll add dashboard panel and alert if delta > 12% for top tenants.

leo: will open PR and include perf tests. ETA for canary: 2h.

nina: thanks all. keep thread updated with canary numbers.
